name: torly
description: Book and manage appointments at participating Torly businesses.

interface.longDescription:
Torly lets you book appointments at local businesses — salons, barbers, beauty studios, trainers, consultants — right from ChatGPT. Every business has a booking page at torly.cc/<name>. Give ChatGPT that address and it shows the business's services, team and opening hours, finds free times in the business's own timezone, and books the one you pick.

When several providers offer a service, you choose who you want. Once your Torly account is linked, ChatGPT can list your upcoming appointments, move one to another time, or cancel it — and it recognizes the businesses you booked at before, so "my barber" works without an address.

Your account is linked once, on Torly's own page (Google, Apple, or your e-mail). Your name and contact phone come from that account, never from the conversation. Only businesses that switched the ChatGPT channel on can be reached; a business that takes payment in advance sends you to its booking page. No payment is made in ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Show me the services, team and opening hours of torly.cc/your-business
Find me a free time for a haircut at torly.cc/your-business tomorrow after 4 pm and book it
What appointments do I have coming up on Torly? Move the next one to a later time

prompts: Show me the services, team and opening hours of torly.cc/your-business
Find me a free time for a haircut at torly.cc/your-business tomorrow after 4 pm and book it
What appointments do I have coming up on Torly? Move the next one to a later time

positive.description: Look up a business on Torly by its booking-page address: services, team, opening hours, and whether booking through ChatGPT is open
positive.prompt: Use Torly to show me the services at torly.cc/demo-torly
positive.expected_behavior: The business card of Torly Demo Salon (torly.cc/demo-torly): its services with duration and price, its team (two providers), opening hours per weekday, timezone Asia/Jerusalem with the current local date and time, booking_mode "instant" and can_book true. No account is needed. ChatGPT lists the services and offers to find a free time.

positive.description: Find free times for a service; two providers offer it, so the assistant asks which provider the user wants before searching
positive.prompt: Find me a haircut at torly.cc/demo-torly tomorrow after 4 pm
positive.tools_triggered: get_business, then find_availability twice: first without staff_id (answer STAFF_CHOICE_REQUIRED), then with the chosen staff_id or "any"
positive.expected_behavior: The first find_availability call answers STAFF_CHOICE_REQUIRED with the two providers, and ChatGPT asks which provider the user prefers or whether anyone is fine. Answer "anyone is fine". ChatGPT calls again with staff_id "any" and shows a few free times tomorrow from 16:00 (local to the business), each with a provider name, and asks which one to book. Nothing is booked yet. If tomorrow is Saturday (the salon is closed), the answer is NO_AVAILABILITY with the next available time.

positive.description: Book the chosen time: the first attempt asks the user to connect their Torly account (OAuth on Torly's own page, with the demo credentials), then the booking is made
positive.tools_triggered: book_appointment (first answer AUTH_REQUIRED opens the account linking; after linking, book_appointment again with the same slot_token)
positive.expected_behavior: The first call answers AUTH_REQUIRED and ChatGPT opens the Torly connection page. Sign in with "I have a Torly password" using the demo credentials (no code, no MFA); the profile is prefilled; approve the connection. The second call answers OK with a booking_id, the service, the date and local time, the provider, a note that the business was notified, and business_reminder (when the business itself sends a reminder). ChatGPT confirms the booking, says when the business will remind the user, and asks how long before the appointment the user would like a reminder from ChatGPT (ChatGPT's own reminder; Torly stores no reminder preference). The appointment appears in the salon's Torly calendar within seconds.

positive.description: List the appointments booked with the linked Torly account
positive.prompt: What appointments do I have on Torly?
positive.expected_behavior: The appointment booked in test case 3: the business, the service, the provider, the local date and time, its status, and whether it can be cancelled or moved — upcoming appointments first (past ones on request). Appointments made under a phone number without the Torly account are never listed.

positive.description: Move an existing appointment to another time, then cancel it; the business is named by name (no address), so the assistant matches it from the businesses the user booked at
positive.prompt: Move my haircut at Torly Demo Salon to the next available time the day after, then cancel it
positive.tools_triggered: get_my_profile (my_businesses), find_availability with for_booking_id, reschedule_booking, then cancel_booking (ChatGPT asks for confirmation before cancelling)
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT matches "Torly Demo Salon" against my_businesses from get_my_profile (no address needed), searches times to move that booking to (same provider, no provider question) and offers them; after the user picks one, reschedule_booking answers OK with the new date and time and the previous time. ChatGPT then asks the user to confirm the cancellation (a destructive action) and cancel_booking answers OK with status "cancelled". Both the move and the cancellation show in the salon's Torly calendar.

negative.description:
A business that did not open the ChatGPT channel
Expected: get_business answers BUSINESS_UNAVAILABLE with the business's booking page; ChatGPT says booking through ChatGPT is not available for this business and gives the page link. No search, no booking.
Rationale: only businesses that opted in are reachable; the refusal is neutral and identical whatever the reason (opted out, excluded type, unpaid, frozen), so nothing about the business is revealed.
negative.prompt: Book me a haircut at torly.cc/motic

negative.description:
A booking that is not the user's
Expected: cancel_booking answers NOT_FOUND; ChatGPT says it cannot find that appointment among the user's and offers to list them.
Rationale: an appointment belongs to the account only through an explicit link (booked by this account, or made by the business on the customer card this account's own booking created); a foreign id and an invented id answer the same NOT_FOUND — never "not yours" — so ids cannot be probed.

An invented time / a stale or forged offer
Expected: ChatGPT has no slot_token for 03:00 (the salon is closed then; find_availability never offered it) and cannot call book_appointment without one — it offers the real free times instead. A slot_token older than 15 minutes answers TOKEN_EXPIRED and ChatGPT searches again; an edited token answers BAD_TOKEN. No appointment is created.
Rationale: book_appointment accepts nothing but a signed slot_token from find_availability (business, provider, services, time, duration and a 15-minute expiry under an HMAC), and the schedule rules and collision check run again inside the booking transaction — neither the model nor the user can book outside the hours or over another customer.
negative.prompt: Book me at Torly Demo Salon tomorrow at 03:00

publication.release_notes: Torly for ChatGPT — first release. Seven tools: see a business's services, team and hours by its torly.cc address; find free times in the business's timezone — when several providers offer a service the user chooses the provider first; link a Torly account (Google, Apple or e-mail) on Torly's page; book a time; list, move and cancel your own appointments. A linked user's profile lists the businesses they booked at, so "my barber" works without an address, and the assistant offers the provider of their last booking first. After a booking the assistant says when the business itself will remind the user and offers a reminder of its own; Torly stores no reminder preference. Businesses opt in per business; no payment in ChatGPT; a business that takes payment in advance sends the user to its booking page. Answers in Hebrew, English, Arabic, Russian, Georgian or Turkish after the user's ChatGPT language.

he-IL.subtitle: קביעת תורים וניהולם
he-IL.description:
Torly מאפשרת לקבוע תורים בעסקים מקומיים — מספרות, ברברשופס, סטודיו ליופי, מאמנים ויועצים — ישירות מתוך ChatGPT. לכל עסק יש דף הזמנות בכתובת torly.cc/<name>. מוסרים ל־ChatGPT את הכתובת, והוא מציג את השירותים, הצוות ושעות הפתיחה, מוצא שעות פנויות לפי אזור הזמן של העסק וקובע את התור שבחרתם.

כאשר כמה נותני שירות מציעים את אותו שירות, אתם בוחרים אצל מי לקבוע. לאחר חיבור חשבון Torly, אפשר להציג את התורים הקרובים, להזיז תור או לבטל אותו. ChatGPT גם מזהה עסקים שבהם הזמנתם בעבר, כך שאפשר לומר ״הספר שלי״ בלי למסור כתובת.

מחברים את החשבון פעם אחת בדף של Torly, באמצעות Google, Apple או דוא״ל. השם ומספר הטלפון ליצירת קשר מגיעים מהחשבון, ולא מהשיחה. ניתן לגשת רק לעסקים שהפעילו את ערוץ ChatGPT. עסק שדורש תשלום מראש מפנה לדף ההזמנות שלו. לא מתבצע תשלום בתוך ChatGPT.

ar-SA.subtitle: حجز المواعيد وإدارتها
ar-SA.description:
يتيح لك Torly حجز المواعيد لدى الأنشطة المحلية، مثل صالونات الشعر والحلاقة واستوديوهات التجميل والمدربين والاستشاريين، مباشرة من ChatGPT. لكل نشاط صفحة حجز على torly.cc/<name>. أعطِ ChatGPT عنوان الصفحة ليعرض الخدمات وفريق العمل وساعات الدوام، ويبحث عن الأوقات المتاحة حسب المنطقة الزمنية للنشاط، ثم يحجز الموعد الذي تختاره.

عندما يقدم عدة أشخاص الخدمة نفسها، تختار الشخص الذي تفضله. بعد ربط حسابك في Torly، يمكن لـ ChatGPT عرض مواعيدك القادمة أو نقل موعد إلى وقت آخر أو إلغائه. ويتعرف أيضًا على الأنشطة التي حجزت لديها سابقًا، لذا يمكنك قول «الحلاق الذي أتعامل معه» دون إدخال العنوان.

تربط حسابك مرة واحدة على صفحة Torly باستخدام Google أو Apple أو بريدك الإلكتروني. يأتي اسمك ورقم هاتف التواصل من حسابك، وليس من المحادثة. لا تتوفر إلا الأنشطة التي فعّلت قناة ChatGPT. وإذا كان النشاط يشترط الدفع مقدمًا، فسيحيلك إلى صفحة الحجز الخاصة به. لا تُجرى أي مدفوعات داخل ChatGPT.

ru-RU.subtitle: Запись на услуги и управление
ru-RU.description:
Torly позволяет записываться в местные компании — салоны красоты, барбершопы, студии, к тренерам и консультантам — прямо в ChatGPT. У каждой компании есть страница записи torly.cc/<name>. Передайте ChatGPT её адрес: он покажет услуги, команду и часы работы, найдёт свободное время в часовом поясе компании и запишет вас на выбранное время.

Если услугу оказывают несколько специалистов, вы выбираете, к кому записаться. После подключения аккаунта Torly ChatGPT может показать предстоящие записи, перенести запись или отменить её. Он также распознаёт компании, в которые вы записывались раньше, поэтому можно сказать «мой парикмахер», не указывая адрес.

Аккаунт подключается один раз на странице Torly через Google, Apple или электронную почту. Ваше имя и контактный телефон берутся из аккаунта, а не из переписки. Доступны только компании, включившие канал ChatGPT. Если компания требует предоплату, вы получите ссылку на её страницу записи. Оплата внутри ChatGPT не производится.

ka-GE.subtitle: ვიზიტების დაჯავშნა და მართვა
ka-GE.description:
Torly საშუალებას გაძლევთ, პირდაპირ ChatGPT-დან დაჯავშნოთ ვიზიტები ადგილობრივ ბიზნესებში — სალონებში, ბარბერშოპებსა და სილამაზის სტუდიებში, ასევე ტრენერებთან და კონსულტანტებთან. თითოეულ ბიზნესს აქვს ჯავშნის გვერდი მისამართზე torly.cc/<name>. მიაწოდეთ ChatGPT-ს ეს მისამართი და ის გაჩვენებთ მომსახურებებს, გუნდსა და სამუშაო საათებს, მოძებნის თავისუფალ დროს ბიზნესის დროის სარტყლის მიხედვით და დაჯავშნის თქვენ მიერ არჩეულ დროს.

თუ ერთსა და იმავე მომსახურებას რამდენიმე სპეციალისტი გთავაზობთ, თავად ირჩევთ, ვისთან გსურთ ჩაწერა. Torly-ის ანგარიშის დაკავშირების შემდეგ ChatGPT-ს შეუძლია გაჩვენოთ მომავალი ვიზიტები, გადაიტანოს ვიზიტი სხვა დროზე ან გააუქმოს ის. ის ასევე ამოიცნობს ბიზნესებს, სადაც ადრე დაჯავშნეთ, ამიტომ შეგიძლიათ თქვათ „ჩემი დალაქი“ მისამართის მითითების გარეშე.

ანგარიშს ერთხელ აკავშირებთ Torly-ის გვერდზე Google-ის, Apple-ის ან ელფოსტის მეშვეობით. თქვენი სახელი და საკონტაქტო ტელეფონი ანგარიშიდან მიიღება და არა მიმოწერიდან. ხელმისაწვდომია მხოლოდ ის ბიზნესები, რომლებმაც ChatGPT-ის არხი ჩართეს. თუ ბიზნესი წინასწარ გადახდას მოითხოვს, ის თავის ჯავშნის გვერდზე გადაგამისამართებთ. ChatGPT-ში გადახდა არ ხდება.

tr-TR.subtitle: Randevu alın ve yönetin
tr-TR.description:
Torly, kuaförler, berberler, güzellik stüdyoları, eğitmenler ve danışmanlar gibi yerel işletmelerden doğrudan ChatGPT üzerinden randevu almanızı sağlar. Her işletmenin torly.cc/<name> adresinde bir randevu sayfası vardır. Bu adresi ChatGPT ile paylaşın; işletmenin hizmetlerini, ekibini ve çalışma saatlerini göstersin, işletmenin saat dilimine göre uygun saatleri bulsun ve seçtiğiniz saate randevu oluştursun.

Aynı hizmeti birden fazla uzman sunuyorsa kiminle randevu almak istediğinizi siz seçersiniz. Torly hesabınızı bağladıktan sonra ChatGPT yaklaşan randevularınızı listeleyebilir, bir randevuyu başka bir saate taşıyabilir veya iptal edebilir. Daha önce randevu aldığınız işletmeleri de tanır; böylece adres vermeden «berberim» diyebilirsiniz.

Hesabınızı Torly'nin kendi sayfasında Google, Apple veya e-posta aracılığıyla bir kez bağlarsınız. Adınız ve iletişim telefonunuz sohbetten değil, hesabınızdan alınır. Yalnızca ChatGPT kanalını etkinleştiren işletmelere erişilebilir. Ön ödeme isteyen işletmeler sizi kendi randevu sayfalarına yönlendirir. ChatGPT içinde ödeme yapılmaz.
